notes: Orientation filter: the x-io Fusion AHRS (MIT) replaces the Madgwick filter. On the recorded squat sets available, per-rep results matched the previous filter within the engine's own noise; accuracy against a reference encoder is still to be validated. CALIBRATE fix, update recommended: the starting orientation after CALIBRATE had the tilt mirrored, so a set started right after calibrating, while the filter was still recovering, could report badly wrong values. Sets can now start right after CALIBRATE. Serial log, new since 3.11.31: S-row columns accRawX/Y/Z, accelScaleG and accBiasX/Y/Z, start and end times on P rows, an INFO line at each START and a TIMING line at each STOP. New serial commands: VERSION, TIMING [RESET], FILTER (read-only). BLE packets unchanged. Tools: new full_replay offline replay and regression test, live monitor shows the firmware version. Licence: from 3.12.0 the firmware is open core (tracking engine PolyForm Noncommercial with additional permissions, the rest Apache-2.0, see LICENSE); 3.11.31 and earlier stay GPL-3.0 with the Commons Clause. Updating from the app requires the OTAFIX bootloader: https://github.com/ODKI-tech/ODKI-VBT/blob/main/Hardware/Instructions/BOOTLOADER.md Known limitation: the sensor samples at about 95 Hz instead of 100 Hz (velocities are not biased; sample-counted windows are about 5 percent longer); a fix is planned.
